name: Doorknock
tagline: Read the room before you walk in — a source-audited one-page brief.
description:
Doorknock writes a one-page briefing for the meeting you're about to walk in.

Tell it who you're meeting — a company, or a person in a public role — and when. It sweeps the last 30 days of the web, drafts a brief from the transcript it fetched, and a deterministic auditor rejects anything it cannot trace: every development must cite a URL the sweep actually returned, and every number, amount, percentage or date must appear in the excerpt the model actually saw. A real citation does not rescue an invented figure. Claims that survive land in the brief; claims that don't are kept — flagged — under Uncertain.

Data sources & credentials: Doorknock uses ONLY Anna's host-managed APIs — anna.web.search for the sweep (host routes Tavily, falling back to DDG; results are provider-agnostic snippets with title, URL, snippet and optional published date) and anna.llm.complete for the query plan and draft (your chosen Anna model, billed to your own Anna CU quota). It holds no API keys, needs no third-party credentials, and talks to no external databases or websites directly — the host does all fetching. Fetching happens ONLY at runtime when you press Knock: one query-planning call, then 4 searches per run (1 evergreen identity + 3 news searches restricted to the last 30 days), then one draft plus at most one redraft and one longer retry. There is no background refresh, no tracking, and no data sale.

Storage & privacy: briefs and the interrupted-run checkpoint are saved ONLY in your own Anna app storage (your private app bucket) as briefs/<timestamp> and briefs/last; reopening, Resume, Last-brief and the on-device library read from there. Nothing is shared with other users. Briefs on private individuals are out of scope — use a company or a public-role person. Always read the cited sources before relying on a claim.

The result is a saved, source-audited one-page briefing: headline, situation, key developments each with their source links, discussion points, open questions, a grounding score, and the full source list, reopenable or copyable as text. If a run is interrupted, Doorknock offers to resume where the sweep left off without re-searching.

Quota: each brief spends your Anna quota on the plan call, the 4-search sweep (basic depth), and up to two drafting calls. If your quota is too low the app tells you the required vs remaining CU instead of failing silently.
